notes.title: Post release patch
notes.content:
Balance:
- Reduced Gorath's Stun radius.
- Significantly increased Atlas' Attack Speed.
- Reworked Atlas Out Of Mana event: If Atlas depletes all of his Mana, he will now become invincible for 3 seconds and refill his Mana bar.
- Increased Sera's Primary projectile and attack speed.

Fixes:
- Fixed issues where targeting abilities couldn't be used on clients in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where multiple instances of a sound would play at the same time.
- Fixed Lyra's decoy not moving correctly on the map "Tokyo".

Bigger patch will come over the next couple of days. Thanks to everyone playing the game.
